paragraphs.text: Ravnica Remastered is the third remastered Magic: The Gathering set in the Masters series to appear in paper . It was released on January 12, 2024.

Ravnica Remastered contains cards from the Ravnica block , the Return to Ravnica block , the Guilds of Ravnica block and Commander product cards that are set on Ravnica (spanning thirteen sets across sixteen years). It is a fully draftable set.

The set features 291 regular cards (110 commons, 90 uncommons, 71 rares, 20 mythic rares) , and includes randomly inserted premium versions of all cards. #282 to 291 are the shock lands , and there are no basic lands . #292 to 301 are borderless shock lands (Collector Boosters only). #302-415 are showcase retro frame versions of a selection of the previous cards, and #416-445 are a selection of borderless versions in an anime art style. Twenty-one Collector Booster exclusive retro frame cards (1 commons, 10 uncommons, 7 rares, 3 mythic rares) are #446-466. #467 is the release card . Collector Boosters also contain serialized versions of the showcase retro frame cards.

The design of the set features all ten Guilds of Ravnica . The designers were able to fit 26 out of the possible 29 guild mechanics into the set, with Undergrowth , Cipher , and Radiance left out for power-level reasons. To make sure that there was an adequate amount of mana fixing for an entire table of ten guilds, a "mana-slot" in every booster was reserved for Guildgates , Signets , shock lands , and/or Chromatic Lantern .

Ravnica Remastered is a special limited-run set. It is sold in Draft Boosters , a Draft Pack and Collector Boosters , featuring alternate art , borderless art and retro frames . It was the last set to feature Draft Boosters.
Friday Night Magic : January 12, 2024
Launch party : January 12–14, 2024
Release card : retro frame Niv-Mizzet, the Firemind

Boros Guildmage is the only guildmage printed with the gold-colored Power/Toughness box of multicolored cards rather than the light grey box of hybrid cards.
Tomik, Distinguished Advokist was printed with an Azorius Senate watermark while the character is a former Guildmaster of the Orzhov Syndicate .
